Name: JP's Resource Totems
Author: juanpa98ar
Description:
[center]﻿[/center]
[center][font=Georgia][b][i][size=6][color=#00ff00][u]Resource Totems[/u][/color][/size][/i][/b][/font][/center]
[font=Georgia]

[color=#ff00ff][size=5][b][i]If an ancestral totem can transport you to other places or make it rain, why couldn't it generate resources? Hey, officer, why are you handcuffing me? Officer??[/i][/b][/size][/color][/font]


[list]
[*][font=Georgia][font=Georgia][size=4]This mod adds 8 powerful totems that you can build at any time if you have the necessary materials.[/size][/font][/font][/*]
[*][font=Georgia][font=Georgia][size=4]Each totem has different construction requirements depending on its power level.[/size][/font][/font][/*]
[*][font=Georgia][font=Georgia][size=4]Each totem can be upgraded with Earth Crystal, Quartz, Diamond, Prismatic Shard, and Fairy Dust.[/size][/font][/font][/*]
[*][font=Georgia][font=Georgia][size=4]Totems have a scalable range of up to 9x9 (which can reach 11x11 for one day using Fairy Dust).[/size][/font][/font][/*]
[*][size=4][font=Georgia][color=#00ff00]Click on them to reveal their range.[/color][/font][/size][/*]
[*][size=4][font=Georgia]Earth Crystal and Quartz increase the radius by half a face, Diamond increases it by one full face, and Prismatic Shard increases the full radius.[/font][/size][/*]
[/list]
[font=Georgia][font=Georgia][img]https://i.postimg.cc/15VBzz1F/Totem.gif[/img][/font][/font]

[font=Georgia]
[b][color=#00ffff][size=5][u]Totems:[/u][/size][/color][/b][/font]

[list]
[*][size=4][font=Georgia][b]Grass Totem:[/b][/font][/size][/*]
[/list][size=4][font=Georgia]It generates Grass every day within its range. It can even generate Grass on stone or wooden surfaces, among others. [/font]
[font=Georgia]Super Totem: 50 Wood, 40 Stone, 3 Grass Starter, 1 Fairy Dust.[/font][/size]

[list]
[*][size=4][font=Georgia][b]Blue Grass Totem:[/b][/font][/size][/*]
[/list][size=4][font=Georgia]It generates Blue Grass every day within its range. It can even generate Blue Grass on stone or wooden surfaces, among others. [/font]
[font=Georgia]Super Totem: 100 Wood, 80 Stone, 3 Blue Grass Starter, 1 Fairy Dust.[/font][/size]

[list]
[*][size=4][font=Georgia][b]Mushroom Totem[/b][/font][/size][/*]
[/list][size=4][font=Georgia]It generates all kinds of mushrooms every day; common mushrooms are more likely to appear than others. [/font]
[font=Georgia]Super Totem: 50 Wood, 40 Stone, 10 Clay, 1 Iridium Bar.[/font][/size]

[list]
[*][size=4][font=Georgia][b]Tree Totem:[/b][/font][/size][/*]
[/list][size=4][font=Georgia]It generates tree seeds within its radius daily; there is a small chance that these will be tree mushroom seeds. Trees within its radius will advance to the next stage with a 100% chance the following day. [/font]
[font=Georgia]Super Totem: 50 Wood, 40 Stone, 3 Solar Essence, 3 Tree Fertilizer.[/font][/size]

[list]
[*][size=4][font=Georgia][b]Soil Totem:[/b][/font][/size][/*]
[/list][size=4][font=Georgia]Keep the soil moist, apply Quality Fertilizer, and boost crop growth by 33%.[/font]
[font=Georgia]Super Totem: 120 Wood, 100 Stone, 2 Quality Sprinkler, 1 Prismatic Shard.[/font][/size]

[list]
[*][size=4][font=Georgia][b]Ore Totem: [/b][/font][/size][/*]
[/list][size=4][font=Georgia]It generates rocks and, rarely, rocks containing minerals such as copper or iron, etc. Very rarely does it generate rocks containing diamonds or other precious stones. [/font]
[font=Georgia]Super Totem: 60 Wood, 50 Stone, 5 Gold Ore, 3 Iridium Ore.[/font][/size]

[list]
[*][size=4][font=Georgia][b]Fruit Totem: [/b][/font][/size][/*]
[/list][size=4][font=Georgia]It produces fruit within its radius. [/font]
[font=Georgia]Super Totem: 50 Wood, 40 Stone, 3 Earth Crystal, 1 Diamond.[/font][/size]

[list]
[*][size=4][font=Georgia][b]Monster Totem: [/b][/font][/size][/*]
[/list][size=4][font=Georgia]Generates monster loot. [/font]
[font=Georgia]Super Totem: 50 Wood, 40 Stone, 8 Bug Meat, 2 Iridium Bar.[/font][/size]


[font=Georgia][i][color=#00ff00][size=5][b]That's it. Resources are generated randomly at the start of each day, though sometimes none are generated. Uncollected resources are removed at the end of the month. [/b][/size][/color][/i]


[i][color=#ffff00][size=6][u]Translations[/u][/size][/color][/i]
[size=4]You are free to translate the mod; [color=#ff0000]you don't need to ask my permission[/color].
You can publish it yourself on Nexusmods or send it to me to integrate it, it's up to you.
If you like, you can also let me know that your translation has been published, so I know you're out there.[/size][/font]
